# Fitaa Creative

> Creative and digital marketing agency in East Legon, Accra, Ghana. Gets businesses found, chosen and fully booked: Google Business Profile and WhatsApp Business setup, premium websites with WhatsApp booking, Meta ads management, and graphic and digital design. Works with clients in Ghana and abroad, including the UK. Founded by Nigel Dzameshie.

Contact: WhatsApp or call +233 24 280 5256, email fitaaba@gmail.com. Address: 7 Boundary Rd, East Legon, Accra.

## Pages

- [Fitaa Creative](https://fitaacreative.com/): services, selected work for brands in Accra, and the enquiry form.
- [Fully Booked by Fitaa](https://fitaacreative.com/fully-booked): the three packages in full, for any business that takes bookings or enquiries (car rentals, clinics, short-let hosts, studios and more). Get Found GHS 1,500 / £95 / $130 one-off, live in 5 days (Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business, click-to-chat link, QR card). Get Chosen GHS 3,500 / £225 / $300 one-off, live in 7 days (a premium one-page website on your own web address, built for Google and AI answers, with WhatsApp booking); founding price GHS 2,500 / £160 / $215 for the first 3 clients. Stay Booked GHS 1,200 / £75 / $100 a month, 3-month minimum (Meta ads management, updates, monthly report; ad budget separate). Upkeep only GHS 350 / £25 / $30 a month. Live in 7 days, or 50% of your fee back. Payment is half to start and half on approval.
- Graphic and digital design (logos, brand identity, print, social graphics, artwork for LED and digital screens): quoted per project.
